components.title: RKE2 cluster
components.description: The Kubernetes distribution of a site: RKE2 in its FIPS build, CIS profile, Canal networking.

control-implementations.description: What the site stack's rendered manifests show about the cluster distribution.

implemented-requirements.description: The site stack renders no k3s component.

statements.description: Every release of the site stack, rendered offline from the hash-checked vendored charts with the CI site file, contains no k3s name, image or label; the render test fails on any match outside the generated values of a Secret.
statements.remarks: Your organization installs the site's cluster with RKE2 and keeps k3s to lab and demonstration rigs.

implemented-requirements.description: The cluster audit policy names the events it records.

statements.description: The cluster audit policy (deploy/rke2/audit-policy.yaml) skips the RequestReceived stage, records writes to Theia Cloud sessions, workspaces and app definitions at Request level, records Secrets, ConfigMaps and token reviews at Metadata level only, so no Secret body is recorded, and records every other request at Metadata level. The RKE2 server configuration loads this policy and sets the audit log's path, age, backup count and size.
statements.remarks: Your organization decides how long the site keeps audit records and reviews them.

implemented-requirements.description: The cluster runs with the site's hardened settings.

statements.description: The RKE2 server configuration keeps the CIS profile, Canal networking, no bundled ingress controller, Secrets encryption, no default registry endpoint, the Pod Security admission configuration, and scheduled etcd snapshots with a retention count.
statements.remarks: Your organization installs each node from the reviewed configuration and keeps the hosts patched.

statements.description: Pod Security admission enforces, audits and warns at the restricted level in every namespace except exactly six (cis-operator-system, kube-system, longhorn-system, sterling-log-shipper, sterling-monitoring and tigera-operator), with no exempt users or runtime classes; the site's network release labels each namespace it creates restricted, except the storage, log-shipper and monitoring namespaces.
statements.remarks: Your organization adds no namespace exemption outside a reviewed change.

statements.description: Every namespace a site release uses has an egress-site-only network policy that selects every pod and allows egress only to the cluster's pod, service and node ranges and the site file's egress allow list, with no open rule; nodes pull images only through the site registry mirror, with no public registry named.
statements.remarks: Your organization lists the site's allowed outside addresses in the site file and runs the site's network boundary.

implemented-requirements.description: Kubernetes Secrets are encrypted at rest.

statements.description: The RKE2 server configuration turns on Secrets encryption, so the cluster stores Kubernetes Secrets encrypted in etcd.
statements.remarks: Your organization keeps the escrow copy of each server node's encryption configuration.

implemented-requirements.description: Nodes take their time only from the site's time sources.

statements.description: The chrony configuration written for each node names exactly the site file's time servers, with no pool, peer, local or allow directive; a site file with no time source, a malformed server or an unsupported reference clock is refused; and the node install script runs the clock check before it creates the etcd user, installs the RPM or starts RKE2.
statements.remarks: Your organization runs the site's time servers.

implemented-requirements.description: Every node runs in FIPS mode.

statements.description: On the running site, the signed evidence export counts the cluster's nodes and those whose kernel reports FIPS mode on; the deployment collector passes only when every node reports it.
statements.remarks: Your organization installs each node's operating system in FIPS mode and produces the evidence export at least weekly.
